summary:
**MISSION ARCHITECT: Beyond Earth**

MISSION ARCHITECT: Beyond Earth is an interactive educational game that allows players to experience the challenges of planning a space mission. Players take on the role of mission engineers and make important decisions about spacecraft design, rocket selection, scientific instruments, fuel, mass, energy, communication, and orbital constraints.

The project aims to make space exploration more accessible and engaging through interactive gameplay rather than traditional presentations. By completing mission objectives and managing limited resources, players develop problem-solving, critical-thinking, and engineering skills.

Our goal is to inspire students to explore space science, understand the complexity of real-world space missions, and discover how engineering decisions affect mission success.
details:
Project Details – MISSION ARCHITECT: Beyond Earth

MISSION ARCHITECT: Beyond Earth is an interactive educational game designed to help students understand the complexity of space exploration through hands-on mission planning. Players take on the role of space mission engineers and are challenged to design and manage their own space missions.

The game allows players to make important decisions, including selecting rockets and spacecraft, choosing scientific instruments, managing fuel, mass, energy, and budget, planning communication systems, and considering orbital constraints. Each decision affects the mission's performance and final outcome. Players must balance available resources, solve problems, and make strategic choices to achieve their mission objectives.

The main benefit of this project is making space science more accessible, engaging, and easier to understand. Instead of simply reading scientific information, students can actively explore engineering concepts through interactive challenges. The project also encourages critical thinking, creativity, decision-making, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.

Our expected impact is to inspire more young people to become interested in astronomy, aerospace engineering, and STEM education. We hope the game can become a useful educational tool for schools, science clubs, and students who want to explore space technology in an enjoyable way.

The project was developed using web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and deployed through Netlify. We also used AI-assisted tools such as ChatGPT to support brainstorming, content development, and programming assistance, as well as Canva AI for presentation design.

The creative aspect of MISSION ARCHITECT is its mission-based learning approach. Rather than presenting space exploration as theoretical knowledge, the game transforms it into an interactive engineering experience. Players learn that successful space missions require careful planning, resource management, scientific understanding, and collaboration.

During development, our team considered educational value, gameplay accessibility, user experience, scientific relevance, resource limitations, and the importance of encouraging responsible exploration of space.
